audit.whatIsWrong: Wukong's abilities were referred to by slot and nickname throughout the content layer — 'Q armor-shred', 'R spin', 'the W clone decoy' — and the Crushing Blow auto-reset tell was absent.
audit.why: The packet gives the real names: Stone Skin (P), Crushing Blow (Q), Warrior Trickster (W), Nimbus Strike (E), Cyclone (R). Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset, so his burst opens on an attack wind-up rather than a visible cast — that is the cue to step out of range.
audit.corrected: Real names written into the spikes, wants and phase text; the auto-reset tell written into the Don'ts and the level-3 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was 'Skill' in both layers while its why said this is the first stage where you control the engagement rather than react to it.
audit.why: Realm Warp is the first tool in the matchup that answers his engage instead of surviving it, and the packet chart marks that row for Ryze.
audit.corrected: Row 4 flipped to Ryze in both layers, rating raised to match. Rows 0-3 (Wukong) and 5-6 (Skill) already agreed and were left alone.

audit.why: The four spikes are level 3, level 6, Rod of Ages and Seraph's — that ordering matches the phase text and the win-rate shape (47.11%: a lane lost in levels 1-5 or survived into scaling). Names corrected, ordering untouched.

edits.before: Q poke only — farm, respect everything, and bank Manaflow stacks. You're buying time, not fighting.
edits.after: Crushing Blow shreds armour and resets his auto — farm at Q range and bank Manaflow stacks.

edits.before: W root threatens jungle follow-up, but it's also your kite tool — spending it greedily is how you die.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike dashes through a preemptive W and lands him inside it — root after he commits.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Realm Warp pulls you out of a Cyclone setup, so level 6 is the first stage that you dictate.

edits.before: His only gap-close — he cannot reach you while it is down. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike is his gap-close — while it is down he cannot reach you, and that is your window.

edits.before: Wukong burns Nimbus Strike on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Wukong burns Nimbus Strike on a minion — step up while he has no gap-close.

edits.before: That’s Wukong’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an auto-reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: Wukong's full combo (Q armor-shred into Nimbus Strike dash into R spin) goes live — stay far enough that he cannot open with Q before gapping you.
edits.after: Wukong's full combo (Crushing Blow into Nimbus Strike into Cyclone) goes live — Crushing Blow is an auto-reset, so the wind-up is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Proc Phase Rush with E-Q-W-Q and walk out of his R spin knockup range before it lands
edits.after: Proc Phase Rush with E-Q-W-Q and leave Cyclone's knockup radius before the spin lands

edits.before: Open with Q armor-shred then Nimbus Strike to land inside your W root range before you can cast it
edits.after: Open with Crushing Blow's auto-reset, then Nimbus Strike inside your W range before you can cast

edits.before: Use the W clone decoy to bait your Rune Prison so he can re-engage on the real body
edits.after: Use Warrior Trickster's clone to bait your Rune Prison, then re-engage with the real body

notes: The brief's enemyKit for Wukong is null — no Riot ability text, cooldowns, ranges or flags were available for this matchup. Every correction here is therefore name-level (from the packet's enemyAbilities) plus the one supplied missing-interaction. No cooldown numbers were added, and the inherited 'fifteen-second invitation' line was rewritten to remove its unverifiable number rather than replaced with another. Two inherited claims are unverified and were left untouched: that Realm Warp's cast escapes Cyclone, and that Wukong's Trinity Force timing lands at levels 4-5.
